comment: Professor Tran is one of the nicest professors I have ever had. Although her lectures can get slow and boring at times, she gives you the last ~30 minutes of class to start on the homework. She is really easy to meet for office hours and gives reasonable tests.

Dr. Tran is incredibly sweet—she even brings snacks to class! She's very accessible outside of class and truly cares about her students. While her lectures can move quickly and there are lots of assignments (activity sheets, projects, exams), she's always happy to review material and guide you through it. A great professor!
super nice. easy to reach out
Happy to help inside out class. But teaching is not great, basically solo lecturer .

Probably the youngest professor in bschool - she is a sweetheart and very caring and helps a lot outside class. Almost like an elder sister. I had her during her first year teaching and she did a better job than 95% of UR professors. Wasn't the most engaging at first but she defo is now. Exam questions come directly from hw and activity sheets
Bschool 🐐 in the making. Dr Tran is very sweet, caring and goes out of her way to help students out in
70% of the final grade consists of two midterms and a comprehensive final which are manageable if you study. Enjoyed this class a lot and left with lots of useful knowledge.

Dr.Tran is so young, sweet, funny, trying to connect with each of you on individual level both in class and office hour. She explains things very clear, her daily activity sheets, weekly-ish hw. It doesn't feel heavy tho. Her exam was exactly what was on hw, and activities sheet. Share a lot of personal experiences. You will love her.

She really is a sweetheart. Goes out of her way to help her students succeed, very accesible in and out of office hours, and gives out tons of extra crediit. Not the most engaging lecturer just yet given this was her first year but her notes, and activity sheets are well representative of what she will test you on in the exams.

Dr. Tran is really sweet and obviously cares about her students and wants them to succeed. However, I had her for her first semester teaching Investments, and the quality of teaching is just not there yet. You'll definitely be fine if you take her class, but there are better professor for Investments.

Professor Tran is an awesome professor and person. She gives out a lot of extra credit and wants her students to succeed. She also makes the classroom a fun environment. She even bought our whole class muffins one time! She is the best!
